name: preservation-k1
family: Krea 2 measured-preservation ladder on image edits (E-K1)
origin: tranche 2 (Flux 7ed5ewa); scripts ported from test-results/experiments/tranche2/scripts/{build_k1,run_k1,analyze_k1,t1_metrics}.py — vocabulary docs/research/krea2-edit-mode.md §4
measures: Outside-region PSNR + dE76 (32-px boundary band excluded then included — separates AnyPaint's blend band from true drift), meanAD, VAE round-trip floor as the measurement floor, ArcFace identity through edits.

fixtures.scene: 1024x1024 stills: src1 woman+handbag portrait (kitchen window bench), src2 rustic kitchen counter

sourcePrompts.src1: Studio portrait of a woman in her early thirties with a short black bob haircut and thin silver hoop earrings, wearing a rust-orange wool coat, seated on a wooden bench beside a sunlit kitchen window; a bright red leather handbag sits on the bench to her right, fully visible. Soft warm daylight, photographic, sharp focus.
sourcePrompts.src2: A rustic kitchen counter scene in late-afternoon light: a copper pot of soup with steam rising at center-left, a wooden cutting board with lemons at right, weathered wooden counter surface, a window with white curtains behind. Photographic, sharp focus, no people.

editPairs.instruct: Change her coat from rust-orange to a deep forest-green wool coat.
editPairs.removal: Remove the red leather handbag from the bench.
editPairs.inpaint: a bowl of ripe lemons on the wooden counter, consistent lighting and detail
editPairs.outpaint: a complete coherent image, consistent lighting, perspective, and detail: the rustic kitchen continues naturally with more wooden counter, a dresser with ceramic jars, and the window light falling across it

fixtures.maskBoxes: boxes.json (committed) — src1_handbag / src1_coat / src2_counter_right pixel boxes
fixtures.inputAssets: testbed input/exp_k1/ (src1.png, src2.png + derived masks — staged by run_k1.py src|masks)

models.textEncoder: qwen3-vl-4b.safetensors (bf16 with vision tower; fp8_scaled not on testbed — substitution documented)

ie_instruct.label: Identity Edit on Turbo (8 steps CFG1, grounding 768, ref_boost 1)

ap_inpaint.label: AnyPaint masked refine — the measured preservation ceiling (47.1 dB excl-ring outside-mask)

ie_removal.label: Identity Edit on RAW (CFG3, 20 steps, grounded negative)

recipe_index.label: core ReferenceLatent carrier via EditModelReferenceMethod(index) — on-recipe

recipe_t0.label: index_timestep_zero — ostris recipe, off-recipe (measured BAD: meanAD 40)

vae_floor.label: VAEEncode->VAEDecode round trip — the measurement floor (~46 dB)

candidateSlot.description: A candidate EDIT PATH on the same source+instruction: a new identity-edit LoRA version, an alternative unet, or a recipe tweak (steps/cfg/grounding/ref_boost/instruction). Measured against ie_instruct (the edit incumbent) with the AnyPaint ceiling and the VAE floor as reference rows.

slotFields.lora: LoRA file name (default the identity-edit v1_2 incumbent)
slotFields.cfg: default 1.0 (CFG>1 grounds the negative per the pack docs)
slotFields.catalogId: optional fetch-catalog id — run.mjs fetches it first and surfaces the license at run start

rubric.pair: Edited still vs its source. Judge: (1) did the instruction land (green coat / handbag gone / lemons bowl / extended kitchen)? (2) OUTSIDE the edit region: face identity, earrings, bench, counter, window — preserved pixel-faithfully or re-synthesized? (3) boundary: visible seam/blend band at the edit edge?

limits: 1024x1024 STILLS — video preservation is a different regime (see hybrid-ab for H3 video edits).
Outside-region PSNR conflates edit leakage and compression; the 32-px ring exclusion separates AnyPaint's intentional blend band.
The identity-edit v1_2 LoRA is a single version; a candidate version bump may also need its pack's node updates (record pack pins).
dE76 via manual sRGB->Lab (D65) — accurate enough for drift comparison, not colorimetry.
